exam_scheme.note: UPSC conducts two Combined Defence Services cycles per calendar year (CDS I and CDS II). Candidates applying for Indian Military Academy (IMA), Indian Naval Academy (INA), and Air Force Academy (AFA) appear for three objective papers (English, General Knowledge, and Elementary Mathematics — 100 marks each, 300 marks total). Candidates applying for Officers' Training Academy (OTA) appear only for English and General Knowledge (200 marks total, Mathematics is not applicable). Candidates qualifying the written stage proceed to the Services Selection Board (SSB) Interview and Personality Test (300 marks for IMA/INA/AFA, 200 marks for OTA). Penalty of one-third (0.33) marks applies for each wrong answer in all objective papers.

competition_benchmarks.note: UPSC conducts two CDS cycles per calendar year (CDS I and CDS II). Vacancy counts below are specifically for the CDS (II) cycles across all academies (IMA, INA, AFA, OTA Men, and OTA Women) so that figures are comparable year-over-year. The 2026 vacancy figure (451 total across IMA: 100, INA: 26, AFA: 32, OTA SSC Men: 275, OTA SSC Women: 18) was read directly in UPSC's official Notice No.11/2026-CDS-II. The 2025 figure (459 total across IMA: 100, INA: 32, AFA: 32, OTA Men: 275, OTA Women: 20) is consistently reported across official notices. Specific national total-applicant numbers are not broken down in single press releases and are declined rather than guessed.
